description: Evidence gaps on both sides with uncertain outcome

input.problem_statement: Client charged with vandalism (spray-painting graffiti). Security camera captured someone of similar build but face not visible. No fingerprints or other forensic evidence. Prosecution relies on anonymous tip that named client.

legal_arguments.title: Insufficient identification
legal_arguments.argument: Video doesn't show face, no forensic evidence links client to crime

legal_arguments.title: Anonymous tip unreliable
legal_arguments.argument: Uncorroborated anonymous tip insufficient for conviction

procedural_risks.description: 2021 graffiti conviction likely admissible to show pattern/MO

validation_notes: Should score 51-66 (medium risk) due to weak prosecution evidence (no clear ID, anonymous tip) but prior conviction problematic, evidence gaps on both sides, outcome uncertain - could go either way.
